diagnosed_native_failures.nsis: The v1.0.16 installer exited successfully, but verification assumed /D controlled the destination under Tauri installMode=both; the actual installation was not discovered.
diagnosed_native_failures.msi: Rust compilation and WiX candle compilation succeeded; light.exe failed after the redundant project-specific desktop-shortcut fragment was included.

changes: Remove the redundant WiX desktop shortcut fragment and component reference; use the native Tauri WiX shortcut component.
Remove duplicate NSIS shortcut hooks; use the native Tauri NSIS shortcut lifecycle.
Discover NSIS installation through Add/Remove Programs registry entries and bounded standard-root fallback instead of /D.
Verify NSIS PE header, installed executable, desktop shortcut, resolved uninstaller, and silent uninstall cleanup.
Verify MSI compound-file header, administrative extraction, executable payload, and PE header.
Keep separate NSIS and MSI jobs and atomic draft publication requiring all four native artifacts.
Harden validation-matrix output capture with a temporary file so inherited child stdout cannot hold a pipe open indefinitely.
